That's a wrap! At #CES2026, our Chair and CEO Dr. Lisa Su took the opening keynote stage to unveil a bold vision: AI Everywhere, for Everyone.

We’re entering the era of yotta-scale computing, a new frontier that will redefine what’s possible across cloud, PCs, and the edge. AMD is building the compute foundation for this next era of intelligent systems, and at CES, we shared:

✅ The blueprint for yotta-scale infrastructure, the Helios rack-scale AI platform powered by MI455X GPUs and EPYC “Venice” CPUs and designed for trillion-parameter training

✅ The AMD Instinct MI440X GPU for enterprises and previewed the Instinct MI500 Series

✅ New AMD Ryzen AI platforms for creators, gamers, and developers, setting the standard for the next generation of AI PCs

✅ The Ryzen AI Halo Developer Platform, giving devs everything they need to build and deploy directly on their PC

✅ Our commitment of $150 million to expand access to AI education in classrooms and communities around the world

With our partners, we’re turning the promise of AI into real-world impact. The future is full of potential and we’re just getting started. https://lnkd.in/gxwyGqUV
